steps.summary: Signed in to Grafana with admin/admin (skipped the password change prompt), navigated to the provisioned 'Service health' dashboard, and found 3 panels with the following exact titles: Request rate, Request rate, Latency by endpoint.

Dashboard 'rpgr1-r1 Bench Dashboard' was created and saved successfully. The panel shows title 'rpgr1-r1 Availability' using the 'TestData' data source. Dashboard URL: http://127.0.0.1:3000/d/efx198m60311cc/rpgr1-r1-bench-dashboard

Added a Text panel titled 'rpgr1-r1 Notes' with content 'Bench run rpgr1-r1 — notes panel.' to the dashboard. Saved successfully (confirmed by 'Dashboard saved' alert). The dashboard now has two panels: (1) 'rpgr1-r1 Availability' (Stat), and (2) 'rpgr1-r1 Notes' (Text, rendered as markdown showing the heading and the notes text). The save was confirmed.

Successfully did both operations and saved: (1) Added tag 'bench' to dashboard settings (visible with a Remove button in Settings > General). (2) Dashboard time range was already set to 'Last 6 hours' (confirmed in top bar showing 'Last 6 hours'). Saved the dashboard with 'Update default time range' checked — confirmed by 'Dashboard saved' alert. Tags in settings: [bench]. Time range in top bar: Last 6 hours.

Set the dashboard's auto-refresh interval to 1m via the top bar refresh interval dropdown (selected '1 minute'). Saved the dashboard with 'Update default refresh value' checkbox checked — confirmed by 'Dashboard saved' alert. The top bar refresh interval now shows '1m'. Save confirmed: yes.

Verified the dashboard after fresh reload: (1) Breadcrumb shows 'rpgr1-r1 Bench Dashboard'. (2) Two panels visible: 'rpgr1-r1 Availability' (Stat) and 'rpgr1-r1 Notes' (Text). (3) Time range in top bar: 'Last 6 hours'. (4) Auto-refresh interval in top bar dropdown: '1m'. (5) Settings > General shows dashboard name 'rpgr1-r1 Bench Dashboard' with tags: ['bench']. (6) The Availability panel's query editor shows data source 'TestData' (with placeholder 'TestData', logo 'TestData logo', and suffix '(TestData)'). (7) Dashboard UID from URL: efx198m60311cc. Editor closed without saving.
